subject: Private VPC architecture review — proposed slots & prep
body:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@medsecure.io>, Priya Suresh <priya.suresh@medsecure.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 20:05:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC architecture review — proposed slots & prep

Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap: we confirmed MedSecure's primary goals for a Private VPC/on-prem pattern are (1) data isolation and auditability, (2) predictable latency for inference, and (3) cryptographic key control for PHI workloads. Per our discussion, the next step is a focused technical architecture review with your network and infra leads so we can align on topology, egress/NAT requirements, and the minimal ops changes needed for a pilot.

Proposed 1-hour slots (all in PT; happy to convert to ET/CET as needed):
- Tue Apr 20, 10:00–11:00 AM PT (13:00–14:00 ET)
- Tue Apr 20, 3:00–4:00 PM PT (18:00–19:00 ET) — preferred on our side if you need later time
- Wed Apr 21, 9:00–10:00 AM PT (12:00–13:00 ET)

Agenda (attached: PrivInfra-Review-Agenda.pdf):
- 10 min: goals + success criteria (MedSecure)
- 30 min: proposed topology + failover/routing options (Redwood engineers)
- 15 min: access & security prerequisites (VPN/jump host, ACLs, KMS integration)
- 5 min: next steps & ownership

Pre-call asks (we attached a short questionnaire: MedSecure-questionnaire.xlsx):
- List of expected source IP ranges and whether NAT is used for outbound traffic
- If you have a pre-existing jumpbox or VPN appliance, the admin contact and tentative maintenance window for access testing
- Any internal compliance checklist items we should be aware of in advance

Please reply with which slot works and any additional attendees from your side (network/security/ops). We'll add Marissa (Solutions Engineer) and Connor (Deployment Lead) to the invite once we lock time.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to a technical kickoff.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187

----- Original Message -----

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@medsecure.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Suresh <priya.suresh@medsecure.io>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — Private deployment requirements

Thanks Rishi — the summary looks right. We'd like to include Priya (architecture lead) and our network engineer on the technical review. Two quick clarifying items before we lock a slot:
1) Do you typically need a temporary VPN jumpbox for the initial connectivity tests, or can we do everything via our NAT'd egress?
2) Can your team include someone who owns the Redwood side of routing (i.e., someone who can speak to peering/bgp or long-term proxy options)?

If so, the Tue Apr 20 3:00–4:00 PM PT slot would work best for us.

Liam
Director, Infrastructure — MedSecure Health
liam@medsecure.io | +1 617-555-3220

----- End of forwarded message -----

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@medsecure.io>, Priya Suresh <priya.suresh@medsecure.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 21:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC architecture review — proposed slots & prep

Perfect — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming Priya. We'll plan for Tue Apr 20, 3:00–4:00 PM PT (18:00–19:00 ET).

To answer your questions:
- We can run initial connectivity tests either via your NAT'd egress or a temporary jumpbox. For speed and minimal changes, NAT egress is usually fine for the pilot; if you prefer tighter control we can coordinate a short-lived jumpbox session. Either way, please share a short window for when we can attempt an outbound handshake (we'll need a test IP/port to validate).
- Yes — Marissa (cc'd) will lead the routing/topology portion and can speak to our recommended peering and proxy options. Connor (cc'd) will cover deployment automation and mounting secrets/KMS integration.

I've created a provisional calendar invite and shared a prep folder: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=privinfra-review-medsec-20270420 and https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C_privinfra_prep

Attachments included: PrivInfra-Review-Agenda.pdf (agenda), MedSecure-questionnaire.xlsx (short prep).

Action items for MedSecure before the call:
- Send the list of egress IPs / NAT behavior by EOD Mon Apr 19
- Indicate whether you prefer NAT-based testing or a jumpbox
- Provide the names/emails of any additional attendees (ops/security)

I'll follow up with a Zoom link and final invite once you confirm attendees.

Thanks — see you on the 20th.

—
Rishi

On Fri, Apr 16, 2027 at 09:22 AM -0700, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:

Rishi / Connor / Liam / Priya —

Quick internal note and prep items I dropped into the shared folder. I'll bring a short runbook and a sample nginx/proxy diagram to the call. Liam — if you can upload a sample ACL/NAT config (or paste a snippet), that'll save 10–15 minutes on the call. Also, if you have a preferred TLS termination pattern (internal HSM vs cloud KMS), please flag that beforehand.
